d:
The moral of the episode lies in the holistic view of life, where different streams of knowledge (Upavedas) are interconnected and contribute to the welfare of society. The episode encourages humility, ethical conduct, and the continuous pursuit of knowledge. It warns against the pride of power and the neglect of righteousness, teaching that true victory lies not in defeating others, but in self-mastery and the harmonious integration of knowledge across all domains of life.
